weakness: Shared HMI login and shared remote desktop password; no account procedure, review, or monitoring; leaver process missed OT access and shared passwords
source: P07 assessment (AC-02 objectives); P01 R-002, R-019; P03 G-034
remediation_plan: Termination checklist covering OT accounts, keys, and shared passwords (POL-02 B.5); one-page OT account procedure; named HMI accounts configured by the integrator; quarterly OT user review
milestones: 2026-07-22 remote desktop password changed (done); 2026-09-30 termination checklist in use; 2026-10-31 OT account procedure; 2026-12-31 named HMI accounts live and first quarterly review

weakness: Remote desktop tool always on in unattended mode, with no documented rules, no prior authorization, and use from any device
source: P07 assessment (AC-17 objectives); P01 R-001; P03 G-036; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Turn off unattended access; named accounts for the 3 operators and named integrator technicians; registered devices only; integrator sessions approved and watched (POL-02 B.4, B.7); weekly connection history review
milestones: 2026-09-15 business plan of the remote desktop tool purchased and named accounts created; 2026-09-30 unattended access off and first weekly review recorded
resources_required: About $900 a year (remote desktop business plan)

weakness: Commissioning and default passwords; no PLC program password; device passwords in a spreadsheet all staff can open; shared passwords not changed when people leave
source: P07 assessment (IA-05 objectives; new finding IA-05e.); P01 R-002, R-009, R-023; P03 G-034
remediation_plan: Password manager for the Owner, Office Manager, and Chief Operator; delete the spreadsheet; change HMI administrator and gateway passwords; PLC program password; check both modems for default credentials each quarter
milestones: 2026-08-12 tank modem password changed (done); 2026-09-30 password manager in use and spreadsheet deleted; 2026-10-31 PLC password set; 2026-12-31 all commissioning passwords changed
resources_required: About $120 a year (password manager); integrator about 4 hours

weakness: No MFA on the remote desktop tool, the remote monitoring service, or the MSP-held firewall login
remediation_plan: Turn on MFA for all 5 remote monitoring users and all remote desktop accounts; MSP enables MFA on the firewall management login and sends a screenshot
milestones: 2026-09-15 MFA on the remote monitoring service; 2026-09-30 MFA on the remote desktop tool and firewall login with evidence
resources_required: Included in POAM-002; MSP labor in contract

weakness: No company backup of the PLC program, HMI project, or HMI computer image; office backup never restore-tested and deletable by one account
source: P07 assessment (CP-09 objectives); P01 R-004, R-017; P03 G-024, G-039
remediation_plan: Integrator exports the PLC program and HMI project; encrypted copies on 2 offline drives (plant safe and Owner's office) monthly and after every change; HMI computer image; MSP restore test and 90-day versions for the office backup
milestones: 2026-09-15 first PLC and HMI export on both drives; 2026-09-30 first office restore test, 90-day versions, and HMI computer image
resources_required: Integrator about 6 hours; 2 encrypted drives and a safe shelf (about $300)

weakness: Flat network: office computers and visitor Wi-Fi can reach the PLC and HMI computer; modems on public addresses; boundary not monitored
source: P07 assessment (SC-07 objectives); P01 R-003, R-016; P03 G-043; P04 finding 2
remediation_plan: Separate OT network behind a small industrial firewall with the gateway as the only outbound path; guest Wi-Fi with no route to the plant; modems moved to a carrier private network plan; firewall logs kept 90 days
milestones: 2026-09-30 guest Wi-Fi separated; 2026-10-31 OT network design approved and modems on the private plan; 2026-11-30 OT network live with a current diagram
resources_required: About $4,500 (firewall and MSP and integrator time); about $480 a year (private carrier plan)

weakness: Unneeded services on the HMI computer and modems; tank modem web administration open to the internet; no protocol restrictions to the PLC
source: P07 assessment (CM-07 objectives; new finding CM-07b.[02]); P01 R-023; P03 G-040
remediation_plan: Remove the web browser and unattended remote service from the HMI computer; keep modem web administration off; allow only the SCADA protocol and the gateway on the OT network (with POAM-006)
milestones: 2026-08-12 tank modem web administration turned off (done); 2026-10-31 HMI computer software removed; 2026-11-30 protocol rules live with POAM-006

weakness: No current OT inventory; the 2018 as-built list misses the modems, gateway, switch, and alarm dialer
remediation_plan: Build the OT inventory with model, firmware, network address, location, and owner (POL-04 4.4); review each quarter

weakness: No vulnerability monitoring or scanning; the exposed modem went unnoticed until this assessment
source: P07 assessment (RA-05 objectives); P01 R-023; P03 G-031, G-032
remediation_plan: Enroll in CISA's free vulnerability scanning for the company's internet-facing addresses; subscribe to CISA and EPA water-sector advisories; monthly check of advisories against the OT inventory
milestones: 2026-09-30 scanning enrollment and advisory subscriptions; 2026-11-30 first monthly advisory check recorded against the inventory

weakness: HMI computer not updated since May 2024; OT firmware never reviewed; no test process; outside the MSP contract
source: P07 assessment (SI-02 objectives); P01 R-005; P03 G-041
remediation_plan: Patch plan with the integrator: test each update on the integrator's bench copy, install within 30 days, keep a record; managed malware protection on the HMI computer through the MSP addendum
milestones: 2026-11-30 patch plan and MSP addendum signed; 2026-12-31 first tested update installed
resources_required: Integrator about 8 hours a year; about $400 a year (malware protection)

weakness: No security terms in the integrator, MSP, or remote monitoring contracts; no ongoing oversight of providers
source: P07 assessment (SA-09 objectives); P01 R-014, R-016; P03 G-027
remediation_plan: Contract addenda (POL-02 A.5): named technicians, 24-hour incident notice, approved sessions, return of files; MSP addendum covering the HMI computer; yearly review of the remote monitoring vendor's SOC 2 report
milestones: 2026-08-20 remote monitoring SOC 2 report reviewed (done, P09); 2026-10-31 addenda sent; 2026-12-31 addenda signed
resources_required: Possible small increase in integrator and MSP fees

weakness: No incident response plan at fieldwork; emergency plan's only cyber step is calling the integrator
source: P07 assessment (IR-08 objectives); P03 G-045, G-046
remediation_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook as the emergency plan's cyber annex; print it for the plant binder and the Owner's and Chief Operator's homes; brief all staff; review yearly
milestones: 2026-08-31 runbook approved (done); 2026-09-15 printed copies and contact sheet in place; 2026-10-31 emergency plan revised with the cyber annex

weakness: No security awareness training, phishing exercises, or OT training for anyone
source: P07 assessment (AT-02 objectives); P01 R-007; P03 G-038
remediation_plan: Annual training for all 7 staff and quarterly phishing simulations through the MSP; free federal water-sector OT course for the 3 licensed operators (POL-02 C.4)
milestones: 2026-10-31 first training for all staff; 2026-12-31 first phishing simulation and operator OT course complete
